frozen_claim.name: MODEL_FREE_POPULATION_FIRST_BREAK_LOCATES_EARLY_SINGLE_CELL_LYSIS_EDGE
frozen_claim.statement: The earliest persistent release-like break in the population free-infectious-particle trajectory, detected without fitting the authors' lytic ODE or a latent-period distribution, localizes the independently measured early edge of the single-cell lysis CDF more accurately than a maximum-slope summary and than the time-reversed trajectory.

population_parser.format: CSV with header optional; first numeric column time, next exactly four numeric PFU columns; rows sorted by time after parsing

first_break_detector.ensemble_slope: median across four replicate slopes at each interval
first_break_detector.baseline_center: median ensemble slope over baseline intervals
first_break_detector.baseline_scale: 1.4826*MAD over baseline ensemble slopes; if zero, use 0.05 log10(PFU)/time-unit as fixed floor
first_break_detector.candidate: earliest post-baseline interval whose ensemble slope exceeds baseline_center+2.5*max(baseline_scale,0.05) AND at least 3/4 replicate slopes are positive
first_break_detector.persistence: candidate and immediately following interval both satisfy ensemble slope > baseline_center+1.5*max(baseline_scale,0.05) with at least 3/4 positive replicate slopes
first_break_detector.break_time: right endpoint time of candidate interval

aggregate_baseline.max_slope_time: right endpoint of interval with maximum ensemble_slope; earliest on ties

single_cell_truth.per_time_fraction: pooled across replicate IDs at each sample_time: sum(lysed_plate_count)/sum(infected_plate_count), using only rows with finite counts and denominator>0
single_cell_truth.monotone_cdf: cumulative maximum of the pooled fraction over ascending sample_time

primary_gate.sampling_tolerance: median positive spacing between adjacent single-cell sample times

mirror_control.construction: keep original time grid ascending but reverse each replicate's Y values, then run the identical frozen first-break detector
mirror_control.requirement: reversed detector is NO_BREAK OR abs(reverse_break_time-t10) > abs(native_break_time-t10)

permutation_null.construction: independently permute each replicate's Y values over the fixed time grid using deterministic SHA256('C037'||replicate||permutation_index||original_index) ordering
permutation_null.score: absolute distance from detected break to t10; NO_BREAK receives +infinity
